Package com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog

Class DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog

java.lang.Object
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.HistoryLog
com.jwoglom.pumpx2.pump.messages.response.historyLog.DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog
public class DismissNotificationResponseHistoryLog extends HistoryLog
The response the pump sent to a DismissNotificationRequest (an alert, alarm or reminder acknowledgement sent over Bluetooth), written immediately after the request's history log (opcode 290, requestOpCode 184) in 591/591 records across the Trio/TandemKit logs and the official-app captures. It has the same layout as the generic control-response record (opcode 300, jwoglom/pumpx2#145); the pump logs DismissNotification answers under their own opcode.

In the Trio/TandemKit logs there is exactly one of these per DismissNotificationRequest the app sent (348/348 and 102/102 on two Mobi pumps). responseOpCode is 185 (DismissNotificationResponse) in every record.

The class name is provisional: Tandem's cloud export and the Mobi app's HistoryLogType enum do not name this opcode. See https://github.com/jwoglom/pumpx2/issues/147.

    • getResponseOpCode

      public int getResponseOpCode()
      The opcode of the response the pump sent, as an unsigned byte (the pumpX2 response opCode ANDed with 0xFF). Always 185, DismissNotificationResponse, in the records examined (591 records on four pumps).
      Returns:
      the unsigned opcode of the response

    • getStatus

      public int getStatus()
      The status byte of the DismissNotificationResponse: 0 on success. Every nonzero value that could be checked against live traffic (four records on three pumps) matched a DismissNotificationResponse reporting status 1, e.g. the second of two alarm dismissals the app sent in the same second.
      Returns:
      the response status, 0 for success
